description: (Na)₂LiBiBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiBiBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiBiBr₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form LiBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Br bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form BiBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-Br bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Bi atom.
